limitations: Originality is qualified to the best of our knowledge. The recent parity source and closely related ideal-approximation counterexamples and Frobenius results were checked, together with targeted searches for K0, Euler-congruence, and finite-abelian formulations. An equivalent observation may exist in older exact-category literature under different terminology or may appear independently in follow-up work. No independent validation is asserted.
provenance: A finite-index Grothendieck-group construction extends the parity counterexample of arXiv:2609.18681v1 from a Z/2 obstruction to arbitrary finite abelian obstruction groups and identifies exact object-level stabilization indices.
record_title: Finite-abelian Grothendieck obstructions to object cotorsion completeness
